Ecosystem.title: Ecosystem
Ecosystem.description: In Mexico, Puebla has an articulated industry. These clusters are that articulation, gathered in three tables: transformation, services, and tourism.

turismo.title: Tourism
turismo.description: Those who receive the visit: the city, health, hospitality, and the mountain ranges.

transformacion.title: Transformation
transformacion.description: Those who turn material into product: plastics, auto, textile, food, energy, stone, wood, chemicals, metal, and construction.

servicios.title: Services
servicios.description: Startups, talent, technology, and the creative economy.
